activity_summary: In the afternoon you refused a paragraph for your father and your mother. The letter was still on the board. You had named no one to carry it, and you were not asking a house price of an empty room.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said it and did not pick the pen up.

facets.activity: Named the three children in the letter

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am not writing one this afternoon to make the sheet kinder.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am not asking the empty room.
